
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yclh/p/19688726" title="发布于 2026-03-09 10:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AI开发-python-milvus向量数据库（AI开发-python-langchain框架（3-1向量化） ）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">之前讲了milvus向量数据库如何使用，但是如何把文本信息转成向量？这个问题一直没有讲，今天就讲讲，这是构建RAG关键的一步</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="font-size: 16px">，咱们使用all-MiniLM-L6-v2本地模型将文本转成向量</span>。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">为什么用它最直接的原因是免费还好用，调用各大平台的向量模型是要收费的，所以使用本地化向量模型从部署到使用都是免费的。</span></p>
<br>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">all-MiniLM-L6-v2</code> 是 <strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Sentence-BERT（SBERT）</strong> 系列中最经典、最常用的轻量级文本嵌入模型，核心作用和特点如下：</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">1. 核心功能：文本→向量的 "语义转换器"</h4>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">该模型的核心作用是 <strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">将任意长度的文本（句子 / 短语 / 短段落）转换为固定维度（384 维）的稠密向量（也叫嵌入向量 / Embedding）</strong>，且转换后的向量具备以下关键特性：</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<ul style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">语义关联性</strong>：语义相似的文本，生成的向量在向量空间中的距离也更近（比如 "猫抓老鼠" 和 "猫咪捉老鼠" 的向量相似度极高）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">数值归一化</strong>：输出向量默认做了 L2 归一化，可直接用于余弦相似度计算；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">多语言兼容</strong>：对中文、英文等主流语言都有较好的语义捕捉能力（无需额外适配）。</li>

</ul>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">2. 典型应用场景（为什么这个模型被广泛使用）</h4>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: flex; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: column; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 8px; background: none">
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">表格</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>

<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">3. 模型的核心优势（为什么选它而非其他模型）</h4>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<ul style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">轻量级</strong>：模型体积小（约 800MB）、推理速度快，适合本地部署或低算力场景；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">效果均衡</strong>：在 "速度 - 效果" 权衡中表现最优，384 维向量既保证语义信息量，又避免维度爆炸；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">易用性</strong>：通过 SentenceTransformer 库可一键加载，无需手动处理分词、模型微调等复杂步骤；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">开源免费</strong>：基于 MIT 协议，可商用，无版权限制。</li>

</ul>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">4. 补充说明</h4>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<ul style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">该模型的输出维度固定为 384 维，是 MiniLM 系列（简化版 BERT）的优化版本；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">若需要更高的语义精度，可选择<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">all-mpnet-base-v2</code>（768 维，效果更好但体积更大）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">若需要更低的算力消耗，可选择<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">all-MiniLM-L4-v2</code>（384 维，推理更快）。</li>

</ul>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<p>看看代码部分</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;"># 导入SentenceTransformer库，该库专门用于加载和使用预训练的句子/文本嵌入模型
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

# ===================== 核心配置 =====================
# 本地模型文件的存储路径（需确保该路径下有完整的all-MiniLM-L6-v2模型文件）
model_path = "D:\\pythonProject2024\\pythonProject\\modelTest\\model\\all-MiniLM-L6-v2"

# ===================== 模型加载 =====================
# 加载本地预训练的all-MiniLM-L6-v2模型
# 该模型是轻量级的句子嵌入模型，核心用于将文本转换为固定维度的向量表示
model = SentenceTransformer(model_path)

# ===================== 示例文本 =====================
# 待生成向量嵌入的示例文本列表（支持多语言，中文/英文均可）
sentences = [
    "这是第一个示例句子",
    "这是第二个示例句子",
    "Hello, how are you?"
]

# ===================== 生成向量嵌入 =====================
# 调用模型的encode方法，将文本列表转换为向量嵌入
# encode方法会自动完成文本预处理（分词、归一化）→ 模型推理 → 向量归一化的全流程
embeddings = model.encode(sentences)

# ===================== 结果输出 =====================
# 打印向量维度：all-MiniLM-L6-v2固定输出384维向量
print(f"向量维度: {embeddings.shape[1]}")  # 输出: 向量维度: 384

# 遍历打印每个句子的向量（仅显示前5个元素，避免输出过长）
for i, embedding in enumerate(embeddings):
    print(f"句子 {i+1} 的向量: {embedding[:5]}...")  # 示例输出: 句子 1 的向量: [0.0123, -0.0456, 0.0789, 0.0234, -0.0567]...
</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;数据结果：</p>
<p>向量维度: 384<br>句子 1 的向量: [-0.01811877&nbsp; 0.10055622&nbsp; 0.07948062&nbsp; 0.00487238&nbsp; 0.02543747]...<br>句子 2 的向量: [-0.05084108&nbsp; 0.09896706&nbsp; 0.01865453 -0.02641223 -0.04201426]...<br>句子 3 的向量: [ 0.01909676&nbsp; 0.03446515&nbsp; 0.09162795&nbsp; 0.07016529 -0.02994661]...</p>
<p>补充说明，向量的维度是由选择的向量模型决定的</p>
